name: sticky-content-wrapper

changelog.summary: Added prefers-reduced-motion support: images crossfade instead of clip-path wiping and scaling; content transition is unaffected

title: Sticky Content Wrapper
description: Split-screen sticky scroll with content on one side and images on the other, revealing on scroll

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Background color of the sticky content pane (left side).

props.name: contentEnterYPercent
props.description: Vertical offset (% of content height) each content block starts from before sliding into place.

props.name: contentTransitionDuration
props.description: Duration of each content block's enter/exit transition on the scroll timeline.

props.name: stepGap
props.description: Scroll-timeline distance allotted to each section step — bigger means more scrolling per section.
